0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, on a four-game losing streak, 13th in the East and 4 games back in the Central) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1, on a three-game winning streak, 1st in the East and Atlantic) in the Bulls' seventh game of the season. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though the most recent meeting was a 157-137 Philadelphia win in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
